office_does: The three county commissioners are the county's legislative and executive board: they adopt the budget, set policy and oversee county departments.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Commissioner Brett Wachsmith, in office since 2019, is the only candidate. Nominated in District 3, the seat is elected county-wide.

candidates.summary: Kittitas County commissioner since 2019 and former county treasurer, running unopposed.
highlights: Cites work on mental health, developmental disabilities and veterans' services [S1]
